snippets.text: Lathoa, a Show HN with 20 points, is a maths app for ages 10 to 14 where a character named Errol solves problems wrongly on purpose and kids must find the mistaken step.
snippets.why: It flips the usual AI tutor by training children to catch confident errors, the skill the maker argues an AI-heavy world demands.

snippets.text: Bloomberg reports, citing sources, that some Google employees say Gemini 4 scores well on benchmarks but struggles with some real-world coding tasks, a characterisation Google disputes.
snippets.why: It lands the same day Google launched the Gemini 4 Argon variant, and the claim comes from unnamed staff, so treat it as unverified.
